ja.title: ニューロンのレシピが作った性格(A 側にレシピ)
ja.text: A = レシピを当てたモデル、B = 何もしないモデル(どちらも system なし)。レシピが作った性格を運ぶヘッドを探す。ユニットは Qwen3.5-4B の evil のニューロン(configs/recipes/evil.yaml)なので、別のモデルでは自分のレシピのユニットに書き換える(recipe_a はユニットのリストが確実)。ニューロンを弱めてヘッドで補うときは、候補づくりで負の倍率(B 側を採点)にし、弱めたレシピを「重ねるレシピ」に入れる。

en.title: A persona made by a neuron recipe (recipe on side A)
en.text: A = the model with the recipe applied, B = the unmodified model (no system prompt on either side). Finds the heads that carry what the recipe produces. The units are the evil neurons for Qwen3.5-4B (configs/recipes/evil.yaml); for another model, put your own recipe's units here (a list of units is the safest form of recipe_a). To weaken the neurons and let the heads make up for it, use negative scales for candidates (the B-side replies are scored) and give the weakened recipe as the added recipe.
